method: Every supplied source and selected completion inspected in full-composition contact sheets. Recognizable families compared with current primary sources. Each editorial identity is bound to the selected original WebP SHA-256.

subjects.finding: The Minus Zero title is verified; supplied designs do not authenticate a film incarnation, location or event. These entries explicitly identify fan concepts. Other Godzilla entries use the recognizable character family.

Compared source figures with fourteen official Sunrise character posters, including Haymitch, Lenore, Maysilee, Wyatt, Effie, Caesar and Snow. Six dark-haired figures do not support the official young-Haymitch identification and retain generic Sunrise-inspired descriptions. Unverified tribute names and pendant materials removed.

Billie, Alice, three-eyed Beef Roger, Queen Celeste, Quill and Quire use supported family names. Purple witches have no invented official guard identity. Generic enchanted objects are not named film props. The flower-cart cauldron is an imagined companion, not an authenticated Bucket design. Ten repeated generic witch pose variants were replaced with distinct faces, clothing and complete activities. They are imagined concepts rather than authenticated film characters. The remaining witch-pair gate composition is explicitly a concept.

Classic and modern forms, Amy's hammer, Tails' twin tails and Metal Sonic's mechanical silhouette compared with SEGA references. Sonic 4 costumes, actions and mechanical details are explicitly imagined fan concepts.

Distinguished classic rounded forms from feathered movie forms. Red, Silver, Bomb and Chuck use supported names. Unverified young-bird names and fuzzy spider designs use descriptive wording and fan-concept labels; illustrations do not claim confirmed film scenes.
Recognizable winged statuette described as Game Awards-inspired. People, winners, categories and activities are fictional; no invented result or technical trophy specification.

Images lack sufficient manufacturer evidence for an exact SKU. Use unbranded camera/audio/display glasses and generic household equipment. Wrist controllers and internal-frame diagrams are concepts; no Meta Neural Band, prescription, medical or industrial certification is inferred.
Donkey and elephant are decorative party-symbol interpretations. Red/blue map assignments are not real election results or forecasts. Debate speakers remain generic people, not named politicians.
